comparison: Direct lxml versus preserved extraction input on all existing documents; exact text for most, every LM scoring field checked for all string differences. Current BeautifulSoup-lxml comparator also checked for every legacy difference.
legacy_text_normalization_note: Previously saved pilot text includes earlier html.parser CP1252 entity handling and Windows newline normalization. Existing cached text/scores are preserved. Numeric LM and sentence/topic equivalence checked for every nonidentical string.
generic_fallback_policy: C1 control-code points in extracted text use the original BeautifulSoup-lxml parser; FOMC always uses its original parser; lxml parse exceptions fall back. Existing text and score checkpoints are not rewritten.
content_cache_key: Full content bytes and fomc flag, hashed by Python and equality-checked; URL/doc_id alone cannot yield a cache hit.
validation_scope_note: Performance-parser validation precedes separately documented source-quality repairs (e.g. bounded ARE earnings section, alternate SO/APP exhibits). Those deliberate input changes are not attributed to parser acceleration; existing validated pilot inputs are preserved except reviewed source repairs.
